dataset_spec.name: uci_wbc_original
dataset_spec.description: UCI Wisconsin Breast Cancer Original (699 samples, cytology grades).
dataset_spec.setting: Woman with a breast mass sampled by fine-needle aspiration at the University of Wisconsin Hospitals (1989-1991). A cytopathologist graded nine cytological characteristics of the aspirate on a 1-10 scale, where 1 is closest to benign and 10 is most abnormal.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Fine-needle aspirate cytology grades (1 = closest to benign, 10 = most abnormal):

marginal_adhesion.text_label: Marginal adhesion (cohesion of cells at the edge of clumps)

malignant.question: Based on these cytology grades, was this patient's breast mass malignant on the confirmed diagnosis?
